g.text: 1. Atorvastatin 20mg Tablet — 1 tab PO at bedtime (ONCE daily at night) x 30 days
2. Lisinopril 10mg Tablet — 1 tab PO in the morning (ONCE daily) x 30 days
3. Aspirin 81mg EC Tablet — 1 tab PO daily after breakfast x 30 days
4. Metformin 500mg Tablet — 1 tab PO BID with morning and evening meals x 30 days

svg.text: • Avoid grapefruit juice while taking Atorvastatin (CYP3A4 inhibition hazard).
• Take Lisinopril consistently each morning. Check and log blood pressure weekly.
• Take Aspirin immediately after food. Report any dark stools or unexpected bruising.
• Metformin: Discontinue temporarily before any procedures requiring iodinated contrast media.
